description: The chart illustrates the layer grouping patterns, comparing the numbers of layers across different groups. The horizontal axis represents the groups (G1 to G4) and is labeled accordingly, with the categories ordered from left to right. The vertical axis represents the number of layers in each group, with a linear scale and tick labels at regular intervals. The chart features a bar graph with four groups on the horizontal axis, each with a corresponding set of bars representing the number of layers. The bars are colored in shades of gray, with the height of each bar indicating the number of layers in the respective group. The bar heights vary across the groups, with the "Spindle" pattern having the tallest bar at G1 and G4, and the shortest bar at G2 and G3, while the other patterns show different distributions. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and there is no visual emphasis on any particular bar. Overall, the chart provides a clear visual representation of the different layer grouping patterns, allowing for a comparison of the number of layers across the four groups.
